name: glaude
description: Connects Claude Code to the Glaude desktop companion: a floating bubble that shows when Claude is working, done, or needs you, and lets you reply from it.

answerPermissions.title: Answer permission prompts in Glaude
answerPermissions.description: Show Allow/Deny buttons in Glaude for permission prompts. Claude waits for your answer there (up to 2 minutes, then the terminal prompt appears). Leave off if you use auto mode: it would also hold calls the auto-mode classifier decides.
